purpose: Bind wave evidence to one immutable iteration and source snapshot with deterministic integrity verification.
identity_rule: iteration_id + source_sha + set_id + wave_id + command + cwd
manifest_digest_rule: manifest_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical JSON with manifest_sha256 set to an empty string; the sidecar SHA256 covers the final serialized manifest bytes.
deterministic_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, trailing newline
